# `dj` — `/api/dj`

DJ Toolkit router — launcher + built-in manual for the native Linux DJ/production stack (Mixxx, Ardour, Hydrogen, Surge XT, Vital, Flatseal, Calf/LSP/Dragonfly, Geonkick). Unlike tools.py's TOOLS (web-UI services proxied over HTTP) or studio.py's SIDECARS (backend-managed Python subprocesses with a /health endpoint), these are desktop GUI apps with no HTTP surface at all — status is read by asking the OS what's running (`flatpak ps` for Flatpak apps, `pgrep` for native binaries), and "launch" just spawns the app and forgets it.

| Method | Path | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| GET | [`/api/dj/sessions`](#get-api-dj-sessions) | Bundle definitions for the 'start a session' shortcuts. |
| POST | [`/api/dj/sessions/{session_id}/start`](#post-api-dj-sessions-session-id-start) | Launch every tool in a session bundle, skipping any already running. |
| GET | [`/api/dj/tools`](#get-api-dj-tools) | Every registered DJ/production tool with live running status. |
| GET | [`/api/dj/tools/{tool_id}`](#get-api-dj-tools-tool-id) | Full manual + live status for a single tool. |
| POST | [`/api/dj/tools/{tool_id}/launch`](#post-api-dj-tools-tool-id-launch) | Spawn the tool's GUI app (fire-and-forget). |

<a id="get-api-dj-sessions"></a>
### `GET /api/dj/sessions`

Bundle definitions for the 'start a session' shortcuts.

- Handler: [`list_sessions`](../../../backend/routers/dj.py)
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set

**Response**

- `200`: JSON list, each item JSON object with `id`, the fields of `sess`

<a id="post-api-dj-sessions-session-id-start"></a>
### `POST /api/dj/sessions/{session_id}/start`

Launch every tool in a session bundle, skipping any already running.

- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `session_id` | path | string | yes |  |  |

<a id="get-api-dj-tools"></a>
### `GET /api/dj/tools`

- Handler: [`list_dj_tools`](../../../backend/routers/dj.py)
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set

- `200`: JSON list, each item JSON object with `id`, `name`, `version`, `category`, `role`, `description`, `kind`, `standalone`, `host`, `launchable`, `manual_url`, `manual_label`, `tutorial_url`, `tutorial_label`, `quickstart`, `tips`, `status`

### `POST /api/dj/tools/{tool_id}/launch`

Spawn the tool's GUI app (fire-and-forget).

- Handler: [`launch_dj_tool`](../../../backend/routers/dj.py)

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tool_id` | path | string | yes |  |  |
